about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the dramatic soundtrack of Headquarters: World War II and tune in to the epochal battles that decided the fate of humankind with the excellent music composed and recorded by the Daraba Studio and Ihor Sidak.

The 13 music tracks capture a multitude of moods ranging from upbeat to sorrowful, showcasing the multifaceted nature of the war and the challenges and hardships World War II army soldiers had been going through, with a bittersweet moment of victory in the end.

On the 1-year anniversary of the release celebration, we have added one new music track composed and recorded by Ihor Sidak. 

CREDITS

ARTIST: Daraba studio, Ihor Sidak

COMPOSER: Daraba studio, Ihor Sidak

LABEL: Starni Games

OTHER CREDITS:
Stanislav Dobryanksy

Kirill Akimov

Oleksandr Sienin
